description: This file contains an extension to the OnboardingView class, adding asynchronous methods for handling workspace configuration, initialization, and status management.

methods.name: loadWorkspaceDefaults
methods.description: Loads default workspace settings if not already set, updates the workspace path, and refreshes bootstrap status.

methods.name: ensureDefaultWorkspace
methods.description: Ensures a default workspace exists when in local connection mode; attempts to bootstrap workspace and saves path.

methods.name: refreshBootstrapStatus
methods.description: Updates the internal bootstrap requirement status based on current workspace URL.

methods.name: getWorkspaceBootstrapCommand
methods.description: Constructs a shell command string to initialize the workspace directory and create a markdown file from a template.

methods.name: applyWorkspace
methods.description: Creates or resets the workspace asynchronously, updating status and path accordingly.

methods.name: loadAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Private asynchronous method that loads the current workspace configuration from persistent storage.

methods.name: saveAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Saves the specified workspace string to the persistent configuration asynchronously.

methods.name: buildAndSaveWorkspace
methods.description: Determines the success of saving the workspace configuration and returns a tuple indicating success and an error message if any.
